messages.en:
I didn't get a single word
of that letter you sent!
I'm not the stupid one
here! You're just rude!
messages.et:
Ma ei saanud su kirjast
ühtegi sõna aru! Ma pole
siin see rumal! Sa oled
lihtsalt ebaviisakas!

messages.en:
Your letter was too
garbled to read! It was
more like an abstract
painting! Rewrite it, OK?
messages.et:
Su kiri oli lugemiseks
liiga segane! See oli pigem
nagu abstraktne maal!
Kirjuta see ümber, eks?

messages.en:
Your letter was pure
trash! A romance novel
would have been more
intellectually stimulating!
messages.et:
Su kiri oli puhas praht!
Armastusromaan oleks olnud
intellektuaalselt palju
stimuleerivam!
